title: Unnati Hooda, Tanvi Sharma Advance to Syed Modi Semifinals
indian_angle: Two prominent Indian women's singles players have reached the semi-finals of a significant domestic international tournament.
summary: Indian shuttlers Unnati Hooda and Tanvi Sharma secured their spots in the women's singles semi-finals at the Syed Modi International, with Hooda defeating compatriot Anmol and Sharma overcoming Indonesia's Ni Kadek Pratiwi.

title: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand Enter Syed Modi International Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Defending champions Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, a top Indian women's doubles pair, have progressed to the quarterfinals of the Syed Modi International.
summary: The defending champions Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the quarterfinals of the Syed Modi International by defeating fellow Indian pair Shreya Balaji and Pranavi Natarajan in straight games (21-9, 21-8).

title: BWF's Thomas and Uber Cup Overhaul Sparks Divided Reactions
indian_angle: As a major badminton nation, India's national teams will be directly impacted by the BWF's proposed changes to the format of the prestigious Thomas and Uber Cups.
summary: The Badminton World Federation's proposed revamp of the Thomas and Uber Cup formats, aiming for shorter ties and broader global representation, has met with mixed reactions across the international badminton community.

title: BAI Announces Selection Criteria for Badminton Asia Mixed Team Championships 2027
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has released the criteria for selecting the national squad to represent India at the upcoming Badminton Asia Mixed Team Championships in 2027.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has published the official selection criteria for forming the Indian team that will compete in the Badminton Asia Mixed Team Championships in 2027.

title: Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 Set for December in Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: India's most prestigious domestic badminton event, the 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships, will be held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced that the Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will take place in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17th to 24th.

title: BAI Elections Scheduled for December 26th in Guwahati
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) will hold its forthcoming elections on December 26th, 2026, in Guwahati, a crucial event for the sport's governance in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced that its next elections will be held on December 26th, 2026, in Guwahati, a significant event for the future leadership of Indian badminton.
